spell.invoke.wildshards.name: Pannetti's Wildshards
spell.invoke.wildshards.description: Unleash bounding arcane missiles in spirals around you, each dealing arcane damage..
spell.invoke.frozen_expanse.name: Frozen Expanse
spell.invoke.frozen_expanse.description: Place a frost rune under each enemy in an area in front of you, dealing frost damage and slowing all enemies on the rune after a short delay.
spell.invoke.greater_fireball.name: Janus' Inferno
spell.invoke.greater_fireball.descriptio: Shoot an overcharged fireball, exploding violently for fire damage.
spell.invoke.ice_storm.name: Eos' Blizzard
spell.invoke.ice_storm.description: Ice shards rain on the target area or enemy for the next 4 seconds, each shard dealing frost damage in a small area.
spell.invoke.replicating_missile.name: Pannetti's Replicating Missile
spell.invoke.replicating_missile.descrip: Shoot a chaining, volatile missile which replicates on hit, dealing arcane damage.
spell.invoke.sea_of_lavos.name: Arcane Sea
spell.invoke.sea_of_lavos.description: Place an arcane rune under each enemy in an area in front of you, dealing arcane damage in a small area after a short delay.
spell.invoke.self_immolate.name: Self Immolate
spell.invoke.self_immolate.description: Explode, dealing fire damage to each enemy in an area around you.
spell.invoke.greater_geyser.name: Pillar of Xopec
spell.invoke.greater_geyser.description: Place a large pillar of flames on your location, dealing fire dps in a large area and launching enemies upwards.
spell.invoke.lance_of_eos.name: Lance of Eos
spell.invoke.lance_of_eos.description: Blast all enemies in a narrow cone in front of you, dealing arcane damage to each enemy.
spell.invoke.lance_of_heorot.name: Lance of Heorot
spell.invoke.lance_of_heorot.description: Blast all enemies in a narrow cone in front of you, dealing arcane and frost damage to each enemy.
spell.invoke.rain_of_fire.name: Evard's Embers
spell.invoke.rain_of_fire.description: Launch an ember skywards for each enemy nearby, homing onto its target, dealing fire damage in an area.
spell.invoke.dancing_ember.name: Unvar's Dancing Embers
spell.invoke.dancing_ember.description: Launch eight bouncing, piercing embers that dance around you, dealing fire damage to enemies hit.
spell.invoke.combustion.name: Sozin's Spontaneous Combustion
spell.invoke.combustion.description: Violently explode an enemy, dealing fire damage to all enemies in an area.
spell.invoke.comet.name: Comet
spell.invoke.comet.description: Bring down a frozen chunk on the target area or enemy, dealing frost damage in an area.
spell.invoke.magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
spell.invoke.magic_missile.description: Unleash eight magic bolts in sequence on the target enemy, each homing in and dealing arcane damage.
spell.invoke.plasma_blast.name: Plasma Orb
spell.invoke.plasma_blast.description: Unleash an orb of volatile plasma into the sky, homing onto your target enemy. Deals fire and arcane damage in an area.
spell.invoke.frostferno.name: Frostferno
spell.invoke.frostferno.description: Blast enemies in front of you with frost and flames, each enemy dealing frost damage and fire damage in an area around them, lighting them on fire..
spell.invoke.rimeblaze.name: Rimeblaze
spell.invoke.rimeblaze.description: Ignite all enemies in front of you in an area, dealing frost damage in an area around them after a delay..
spell.invoke.flame_geyser.name: Korell's Flame Geyser
spell.invoke.flame_geyser.description: Geysers erupt underneath nearby enemies, launching them into the air and dealing fire damage to each one.
spell.invoke.frozen_miasma.name: Evard's Miasma
spell.invoke.frozen_miasma.description: Place a lingering frozen miasma underneath you, dealing frost damage per second to enemies standing on it.
spell.invoke.snare.name: Rune Prison
spell.invoke.snare.description: Ensnare an enemy for 4 seconds, dealing negligible arcane damage.
spell.invoke.starfall.name: Stanford's Starfall
spell.invoke.starfall.description: Four miniature star chunks fall on the target area or enemy, each dealing fire damage, arcane damage, and frost damage.
spell.invoke.mass_combustion.name: The Kindling
spell.invoke.mass_combustion.description: All enemies in an area in front of you explode, dealing fire damage in an area around them.
spell.invoke.supernova.name: Stanford's Supernova
spell.invoke.supernova.description: Make an enemy go supernova, exploding and dealing arcane and fire damage to nearby enemies.
spell.invoke.frost_glyph.name: Unvar's Frost Glyph
spell.invoke.frost_glyph.description: Place a frost glyph under you, erupting after a delay, dealing frost damage in an area.
spell.invoke.trailblaze.name: Trailblaze
spell.invoke.trailblaze.description: Conjure a firestorm on yourself for the next 6 seconds.
spell.invoke.runic_invocation.name: Runic Invocation
spell.invoke.runic_invocation.descriptio: Invoke a spell based on your last three runes obtained via spellcasting.
spell.invoke.rah.name: Rah
spell.invoke.rah.description: Shoot a fireball for {damage} fire damage, and gain Fire Power, up to 3.
spell.invoke.heo.name: Heo
spell.invoke.heo.description: Blast a narrow cone in front of you with frost energies, dealing {damage} frost damage. Gain an additional Frost Power, up to 3.
spell.invoke.gon.name: Gon
spell.invoke.gon.description: Blast an enemy with arcane energies for {damage} arcane damage, and gain Arcane Power, up to 3.
